title: Palamod ReCreated ++
description: An update packed with improvements for Palamod Recreated. Discover enhanced features and other secrets, such as the Market, Jobs, and much more!!
body:
# PALAMOD Recreated & More additions
**This mod adds many new items, blocks, commands and systems for Palamod-based gameplay.**

- [Please note that this add-on requires Palamod Recreated to work. Click on it.](https://modrinth.com/mod/paladium)

## Features
- /createchannel <name> <public/private>
Create a new chat channel
- /joinchannel <name>
Join a private channel (requires invitation)
- /setchannel inv <player>
Invite a player to your channel
- /setchannel perm <player>
Give permission to a player to invite others
- /setchannel rule <text>
Add rules to the channel
- /setchannel warn <text>
Add warning message (bad words filter)
- /setchannel leave
Leave the channel
- /setchannel delete
Delete your channel
Faction Commands
- /f → Open faction commands
- /f pay money → Pay faction with money
- /f pay item → Pay faction with item in hand

### !! Players must have required items in inventory to create a faction. !!

## Jobs Commands
- /jobs → Open jobs menu
- /setjobs <player> <job> xp <amount>
**Example:**
- /setjobs player miner xp 100

Adds 100 XP to player job.

## Market Commands
- /market → Open market menu
- /market setcategorie <name>
Create a category using item in hand
- /market setitem <category> <price>
Add item to category with price
Grade Commands
- /grade create <name>
Create a grade (configurable colors)
- /grade add <player> <grade>
Add grade to player
- /grade remove <player>
Remove player grade
Mining System
- /minage
Enable mining HUD (protected within 100 blocks)
# ⚠ WARNING

This mod is NOT intended to replace the original Palamod.

Creating a public server is prohibited
This mod is for personal use only
Not all additions are functional (beta state)
Content may change in future versions
